name: TeamStarWolf - The Ransomware Ecosystem, 2019 to 2026
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2019 to 2026 ransomware record supports: the joint #StopRansomware and other CISA advisories (AA20-302A, AA22-040A, AA22-187A, AA22-294A, AA23-320A, AA23-325A, AA23-352A, AA23-353A, AA24-131A, AA25-203A, AA26-222A, AA26-293A and others), victims' statements and testimony, and ATT&CK's own records. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/RANSOMWARE_ECOSYSTEM.md. Scores: 100 the source prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id.
